title: Alec Issigonis, the man behind the Mini
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: Alec Issigonis turned a small-car brief into a compact architecture that changed everyday motoring.
content:
Alec Issigonis did not make the Mini important by drawing a fashionable small car. He made it important by solving a packaging problem with unusual discipline. The car had to remain short, economical and able to carry four people.

Points to keep in mind

The reason for the project is covered in why the Mini was created in 1959. The technical choices are detailed in the Mini's engineering.

Sources

  • Encyclopaedia Britannica, Sir Alec Issigonis
  • BMW Group PressClub, 1959 - 2019. Sixty Years of MINI
